blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Варгас Жетулиу застрелился более тридцати ___ (годы) назад.
exercises.prompt: Getúlio Vargas killed himself with a gun more than thirty years ago.
exercises.why: (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem.

exercises.q: Сколько раз в ___ (минута) в среднем моргает человек?
exercises.prompt: On average, how many times per minute does a person blink?
exercises.why: The preposition в + acc. is used to indicate the time of the day (*Собрание начинается в три часа.*), the day of the week (*Я был там в пятницу.*), and how frequently something occurs (*Я хожу в штаб два раза в день.*). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.  ·  «The preposition В + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day … (b) to indicate the day of the week … (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: The preposition в + acc. is used to indicate the time of the day (*Собрание начинается в три часа.*), the day of the week (*Я был там в пятницу.*), and how frequently something occurs (*Я хожу в штаб два раза в день.*).

exercises.q: У меня была внематочная беременность два ___ (год) назад.
exercises.prompt: I had an ectopic pregnancy two years ago.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 23.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me').

exercises.q: Устал очень за ___ (зима), — огорчился Фаддей.
exercises.why: (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.  ·  «The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.» — DLI, Lesson 77.

exercises.q: Я жду тебя уж ___ (целый час).
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  «The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" … каждый день, каждое утро, каждую среду (acc.)»; «весь день, всё утро, всю неделю (accus.)». — DLI, Lessons 22, 37.
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: На ___ (следующее утро) я опять отправился к Фустову.
exercises.why: The preposition на + acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place: *Он приехал сюда на два дня.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.  ·  «The preposition НА + Acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: The preposition на + acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place: *Он приехал сюда на два дня.

exercises.q: Сейчас еще мал, но через ___ (год) попрошу — может, примут.
exercises.why: **Под** also has three minor, unrelated uses for which it calls the accusative case: to denote something as being 'designated' for something else ('That bar is designated for celebrities'), to denote something fake ('artificial furniture', **под обстановку**), or to denote an approximate time ('around the evening', **под вечер**) — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Николай Островский, «Как закалялась сталь».
exercises.context: Под** also has three minor, unrelated uses for which it calls the accusative case: to denote something as being 'designated' for something else ('That bar is designated for celebrities'), to denote something fake ('artificial furniture', **под обстановку**),…

exercises.q: ___ (целые дни) проходили в этой мучительной, бесплодной работе.
exercises.why: The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" is rendered as follows: каждый день (понедельник, вторник, четверг) — masc. (acc.); каждое утро (воскресенье) — neut. (acc.); каждую среду (пятницу, субботу) — fem. The word "all" in time expressions answering the question "how long" is rendered as follows: весь день (год, месяц, вторник) — masc. (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.  ·  «The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" … каждый день, каждое утро, каждую среду (acc.)»; «весь день, всё утро, всю неделю (accus.)». — DLI, Lessons 22, 37.
exercises.context: The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" is rendered as follows: каждый день (понедельник, вторник, четверг) — masc.
